The '''''Blunt Force''''' was a [[YV-929 armed freighter]] that was used by the [[Peace Brigade]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. At some point during the conflict, the ''Blunt Force'' and the Peace Brigade [[DP20 gunship/Legends|Corellian gunship]] ''[[Vigor]]'' attacked the refugee [[Starship/Legends|ship]] ''[[Wanderhome]]''.
